'''1996 Coruscant Regionals (New York)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Coruscant region. Its winner earned a place at the World Championship.<ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[David Herzog]] of Roslyn, New York won it.<ref name="dec96" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Coruscant A)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 21 September 1996
* '''Site:''' New York, New York
